title: Data Engineer I
text:
Requirements:
- Python and SQL (strong)
- Experience building ETL pipelines with Airflow or similar
- Apache Spark for large datasets
- Data modelling for analytics (star schema)
- AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift) or equivalent

Preferred:
- Kafka for streaming
- Docker

About us: we process 2 TB of agricultural market data daily.
